violations.text: Accumulation of black/green mold-like substance in the interior of the ice machine/bin. Interior of ice maker and inside of door soiled with mold like substance.
Accumulation of debris on exterior of warewashing machine. Top of dish machine soiled with food debris where doors seal on edges.

Commercially processed reduced oxygen packaged fish bearing a label indicating that it is to remain frozen until time of use no longer frozen and not removed from reduced oxygen package. See stop sale.
Four salmon, five Mahi, and five haddock fillets thawed and not removed from the vacuum package.
Employee with no hair restraint while engaging in food preparation. Employee cooking no hair restraint.
Food stored on floor. Whirl stored on floor, moved to shelf.
In-use ice scoop stored on soiled surface between uses. Stored on top of ice machine. Moved to wash.
In-use tongs stored on equipment door handle between uses. Tongs on oven handle, moved to wash.
Interior of oven/microwave has accumulation of black substance/grease/food debris. Interior of both microwaves soiled with food debris.
Outer openings not protected with self-closing doors. Back door to establishment is not self closing.
Wall soiled with accumulated grease, food debris, and/or dust. Wall by cook line soiled with food debris.
Raw animal food stored over or with unwashed produce. Cracked egg mix over unwashed produce in walk in cooler.
Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food. Raw eggs stored over cooked prime rib in walk in cooler. Raw chicken stored over potatoes in walk in cooler, all moved.
Septic tank system operated beyond approved limitations. Unable to verify limits, operator does not have permit on site. Did have proof of payment.
Stop Sale issued due to food not being in a wholesome, sound condition. Four salmon, five Mahi, and five haddock fillets not removed from vacuum packing prior to thawing.

No soap provided at handwash sink. Hand wash sink end of line.
